title: UN verifies denial of humanitarian access for children
actors: Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups
summary: The report treats denial of humanitarian access as one of the six grave violations against children.
claim: The United Nations verified incidents of denial of humanitarian access for children in the occupied Palestinian territory during 2023.
legal_characterization: UN-verified grave-violation evidence attributed to the Secretary-General’s reporting mechanism; not a court judgment.
source_title: Children and armed conflict in Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territory
verification_notes: Verified against the cited section of the Secretary-General’s dedicated report. Wording preserves the report’s verification posture and does not attribute unverified incidents.
